visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens in a brightly lit indoor event space. A man and a woman stand side-by-side as hosts. The man is wearing a black t-shirt and grey trousers, while the woman wears a black cropped t-shirt and a short white pleated skirt. Both are holding black handheld microphones and smiling towards the camera. The backdrop is a large white wall featuring black line-art graphics of a basketball court and a city skyline silhouette. (2) The scene cuts to a group of approximately eight young children performing a synchronized movement routine. They are all wearing matching white t-shirts with a colorful circular logo. The environment is a spacious hall with polished light-colored flooring. The children are jumping and moving their arms energetically in a choreographed dance. (3) The female host is now at a tabletop basketball shooting arcade game. She is surrounded by a dense crowd of people who are using their smartphones to film and photograph her. She is smiling and focused on the game. The lighting is bright and consistent with a mall or exhibition hall. (4) Multiple short clips show people playing the basketball game. Small orange basketballs are seen rolling and bouncing into mini hoops. The camera captures close-up shots of the balls in motion and the woman host cheering as she participates. The background shows retail signs like 'OSIM', suggesting a shopping mall setting. (5) The woman stands in front of a white wall display covered in hundreds of small black arrow-shaped stickers arranged in a radiating pattern. She carefully adds another sticker to the board and then turns to smile directly at the lens. The background is a clean, modern interior. (6) A rapid montage of still photos and short clips follows, showing the hosts and the group of children posing together while holding basketballs and a promotional banner. The video ends with a static white graphic screen containing the black and teal logo for 'B.LEAGUE HOOP FESTIVAL 2025 in Taipei'.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio starts with a high-energy pop track featuring a male lead singer performing a cover of a popular upbeat song. The music is dominated by a rhythmic drum beat and bright electronic synthesizers. No dialogue is heard from the people appearing on screen, as the music is the primary audio layer. (2) As the video transitions into the child dance segment, the music continues at a steady tempo of 110 BPM. Beneath the music, there is a very faint ambient bed of crowd murmur and room reverb, characteristic of a large indoor public venue or shopping mall atrium. (3) During the game play sequence, the music remains consistent without interruption. There are no distinct physical sound effects for the basketballs hitting the rims, emphasizing the post-produced nature of the audio track where BGM is the focus. (4) A series of quick 'whoosh' sound effects are introduced during the final fast-paced photo montage. These effects are short, high-frequency transients used to synchronize with the rapid visual transitions. The music comes to a sharp stop as the final logo appears on screen.
